title: Scope functions
context: What are the differences between let, run, with, apply and also?

refs.title: Atomic Kotlin (book) by Bruce Eckel & Svetlana Isakova

answer: All five run a block on an object. let and also pass the object as `it`, while run, with and apply use it as `this`. let, run and with return the lambda's result. apply and also return the object itself, which suits configuration and logging. Use let for null-safe work, `apply` to configure a new object, and `also` for side effects like logging. with takes the object as an argument rather than as an extension receiver.

points.title: it versus this
points.why: let and also use it, while run, with and apply use this.

points.title: Return value
points.why: apply and also return the object. let, run and with return the lambda result.
